subject: Correct visualization of datasets with words with accents marks in WINDOWS

messages.author: 3c5c46f91a95889d
messages.subject: Correct visualization of datasets with words with accents marks in WINDOWS
parts:
Dear all,
I've built an application that load data with words with accents marks (i.g. Artà). Additionally the generated output also includes words with accents.

In my MAC OS 10.7.5 everything works smoothly (R 2.15.2 and Firefox 18.0.2) but the problems come when I try to run the application in Windows XP with the R 2.15.2 and Firefox 18.0.2 also. Then, due to some encoding problem the inputs are not well read (Municipi: Artà) and the table is not built properly in the output section. Not only that, some output sentences are even displayed incorrectly. I've attached a photo screen of both cases. Actually in Windows, it doesn't work neither in Chrome and Internet Explorer.

I've checked that both Firefoxs (MAC and Windows) have the same coding parameters in View> Codification of characters > UTF-8. The dataset is read with the following command: read.csv(file,encoding="UTF-8"). I've tried several things but nothing seems to improve the situation.

Any idea? Is the Browser? Is Shiny? is Windows? Any clue how to tackle that?

All the best, and congratulations for this R package.

Josep M.,

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Correct visualization of datasets with words with accents marks in WINDOWS
parts: I honestly am not sure. We have had so much trouble with encoding on Windows. The problem is that UTF-8 cannot be the "system encoding" on Windows. If you could share a minimal code example that might help.
